youtube.title: NAVIGATING THE CRAZY
youtube.summary: Gerry Pyves launches a new show Navigating the Crazy, with psychotherapist and AUT Professor Dr Keith Tudor. They explore how we navigate a confusing world by balancing our inner experience with external reality, questioning authority without rejecting it outright, avoiding echo chambers and finding purpose and meaning. They also discuss how early experiences shape our sense of self, the importance of knowing and accepting ourselves and the value of genuine human connection and open conversation. Discover more from Dr Keith Tudor and Gerry Pyves

youtube.title: CLAIRE BLEAKLEY & ELVIRA DOMMISSE
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with President of GE Free NZ Claire Bleakley and Dr Elvira Dommisse, former genetic engineering researcher, about 102 experimental pesticides, confidential field trials and concerns over the impact on organic farmers. They also discuss genetic engineering, patent-driven agriculture, the HSNO, Gene Technology and ACVM bills and urge the public to contact MPs ahead of their second reading on September 17. For more information: Trilogy of Bills: Hazardous Substances and New Organisms (HSNO) Amendment Bill Gene Technology Bill Agricultural Chemicals and Veterinary Medicines (ACVM) Amendment Bil RCR Media coverage: Brendan Hoare, Organics Aotearoa NZ | Organic Sector Calls for Investment Ahead of Election Joel Salatin, American Regenerative Farmer | A Fresh Path To US Food Freedom? Joel Salatin, American Regenerative Farmer | On His Pioneering Approach To Farming And Healing The Land For everything you need to Say No to the Gene Tech Bill Jayarr Chocolate | Lab grown chocolate future Michael Pollan | No Bar Code

youtube.title: PAUL CONLON
youtube.summary: Michael Arbon talks with Aussie engineer and Citizen One author Paul Conlon about Australia's new digital duty of care legislation, questioning whether shifting responsibility onto platforms to pre-empt “harm” risks censorship and political speech suppression. They examine the failing social media ban for under-16s, expanding regulator powers, and what the Secret Harbour by-election's swing to One Nation reveals about declining trust in Labor and legacy media. Discover more from Paul on his website Paul Conlon or find him on X

youtube.title: DR NICOLAS HULSCHER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan talks with epidemiologist Dr. Nicolas Hulscher about a new study identifying Pfizer plasmid DNA, including spike protein sequences, inside the heart tumor of a 35-year-old man who died of an extremely rare and fast-growing cardiac sarcoma. Hulscher argues the DNA may have integrated into his genome, disabling tumor-suppressor genes and exhausting T-cells, and says batch variability, contamination levels, and continued booster use may explain differing outcomes across vaccinated populations. Follow Nic Hulscher on X or find him on Facebook

youtube.title: MATTHEW PIEPENBURG
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan is rejoined by Matthew Piepenburg, partner at Von Greyerz and author of ‘Rigged to Fail', on America's mounting debt “checkmate.” Matthew traces a path from debt to currency debasement to desperation and dishonesty, pointing to soaring US debt, failing stopgaps like stablecoins and accelerating de-dollarisation as central banks abandon Treasuries for gold. He warns of an overvalued, centrally-propped stock market and predicts growing centralisation and capital controls within two to three years. DISCLAIMER: The views and information shared on this show are for educational and informational purposes only. They do not constitute personalised financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Listeners should seek guidance from a licensed financial professional who can provide advice based on their individual situation. Discover more at Von Greyerz and Matterhorn Asset Management AG – GoldSwitzerland Information

youtube.summary: Solve The Duopoly - Kill The Little Guys? youtube.title: UNDER THE HOOD
youtube.summary: Graham Hood reflects on a 50-year aviation career and the unexpected lessons life has taught him, using the story of an airport firefighter’s final emergency call-out to explore preparation, mistakes, integrity and regret. He looks back on leaving aviation over vaccine mandates, acknowledges what he sacrificed, but remains convinced he made the right choice. As he prepares for his New Zealand tour, Graham encourages us to stop rushing towards the next goal and instead embrace the journey, where character is built and life unfolds. Don't miss Hoody on a Roadie Discover more from Hoody at Club Grubbery or find him on Facebook and X

youtube.title: The food pyramid as it existed came out of the US Department of Agriculture, not health actually...
youtube.summary: "The food pyramid as it existed came out of the US Department of Agriculture, not health actually, in the 1970s, which was a medical misadventure and probably now just a scam, should've been abandoned years ago." - Prof Grant Schofield, Professor of Public Health at Auckland University of Technology If decades of official food advice got the basics wrong, how much damage could that have done to public health? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/prof-grant-schofield-professor-of-public-health-at-auckland-university-of-technology-how-to-fix-a-broken-health-system #RCRMedia

youtube.summary: "Maybe parents just need to start parenting a bit more." - Nicole McKee, ACT Deputy Leader If parents can take the phone away, set the rules and say no, why should taxpayers fund a massive government system to do the parenting for them? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/nicole-mckee-act-deputy-leader-act-promises-to-wind-up-waitangi-tribunal #RCRMedia

youtube.title: If we fined Twitter something like 10% of their annual revenue, for a country of 5 million people...
youtube.summary: "If we fined Twitter something like 10% of their annual revenue, for a country of 5 million people, what is the interest in Twitter to have that liability? It's zero.
